title: EBS scenario: C&I demand-charge peak shaving (PeakSure simulation)
use_case: One 30 kW / 60 kWh EBS-size block reduces a commercial facility's monthly demand peak. PeakSure simulation scenario; not a verified EBS deployment or REON operating profile.

profiles.EBS Na+: simulated (rating from the EBS line heading; cells, N_min, DC floor, R_on, efficiency ASSUMED)
profiles.EBS Li+: not simulated: energy only claimed as 'more than twice ... same form factor'; exact kWh, power and chemistry UNKNOWN

rated_kw: reoncorp.com/hardware: 'EBS | 30kW/60kWh' (line heading; AC/DC boundary not stated)
rated_kwh: same heading; variant not stated. Na+ assignment DERIVED from the Li+ '>2x energy' claim
nominal_ratio_h: 60 kWh / 30 kW = 2 h; nominal ratio, not a guaranteed AC discharge duration
use_case: C&I demand-charge peak shaving: PeakSure scenario; REON's EMS lists peak shaving (REON CLAIM)
window: facility billing peak assumed inside a known window starting HE15; timing uncertainty not modelled
demand_charge: $10-20/kW-month range for illustration; no specific tariff verified
sigma_meas: 2% per-cell capacity estimate error, same for both batteries
cells / N_min / DC floor / R_on / eta: from EBSCase: 120 cells, N_min 108, 300 V floor, 0.1 mOhm, 96%
temperature: not modelled (25 C); REON's -40 to +140 F claim gives no charge/discharge or derating limits
age: new cells (age 0); no ageing or calendar year in this single-event scenario
li_ion: EBS Li+ energy, power and chemistry not stated; not simulated
